## Resources

Follows handbook 5.9 to 5.13. Cluster labels are arbitrary between runs and languages, so the checkpoint compares a cross-tab of clusters against species, not label numbers.

| Step | Python | R | MATLAB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wk 1: PCA and manifold learning | [Handbook 5.9: PCA](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.09-principal-component-analysis.html); [5.10: Manifold learning](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.10-manifold-learning.html); ISLP ch. 12 | ISLR2 ch. 12: Unsupervised learning (PCA lab); [TMwR ch. 16: Dimensionality reduction](https://www.tmwr.org/dimensionality) (PCA, UMAP); the [Rtsne package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Rtsne) for t-SNE | MathWorks docs: [Principal component analysis](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/principal-component-analysis-pca.html); function pages [pca](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/pca.html), [tsne](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/tsne.html), [mdscale](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/mdscale.html) |
| Wk 2: k-means and Gaussian mixtures | [Handbook 5.11: k-means](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.11-k-means.html); [5.12: Gaussian mixture models](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.12-gaussian-mixtures.html) | ISLR2 ch. 12 (k-means lab); base R ; the [mclust package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=mclust) for mixture models | MathWorks docs: [Introduction to k-means clustering](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/k-means-clustering.html); function pages [kmeans](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/kmeans.html) and [fitgmdist](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/fitgmdist.html) |
